question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
-- Get last rows to verify completeness
WITH match_results AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        m.league_id,
        m.country_id,
        t1.team_long_name AS team_name,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
             WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END AS home_points,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
             WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END AS away_points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t1 ON m.home_team_api_id = t1.team_api_id
    JOIN Team t2 ON m.away_team_api_id = t2.team_api_id
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_name,
        SUM(CAST(home_points AS INTEGER)) + SUM(CAST(away_points AS INTEGER)) AS total_points
    FROM match_results
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_name,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league_id ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_name ASC) AS rn
    FROM team_points
)
SELECT 
    r.season,
    l.name AS league,
    c.name AS country,
    r.team_name,
    CAST(r.total_points AS INTEGER) AS total_points
FROM ranked r
JOIN League l ON r.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON r.country_id = c.id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r.season DESC, r.league_id
